bfz.text: Jori En is a wounded merfolk who saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi, and Nissa carries her and fights on until kor on a floating rock rescue them and Gideon hauls everyone to safety, reuniting with Jori.

Jace meets her and offers to read her mind instead of using her knowledge of the hedron research, and he sees her memories of Kendrin's team, who died to the Eldrazi before passing on enough of what they knew.

Jace and Jori set out for the Eye of Ugin without Gideon, and the kor woman Ayli rescues them from Eldrazi spawn only to present them as offerings to Ulamog, whom the Eternal Pilgrims worship, until Jace's illusion of fire lets them escape.

Jace learns that Ulamog is heading for Sea Gate and goes on to the Eye alone, altering Jori's mind to make her think she chose to return, so she walks on toward Sea Gate, cursing him, to warn the survivors.
